meta.name: Sussy / 001 — Roblox developer portfolio
meta.description: Design DNA of this site, read from its own source (app/globals.css, app/layout.tsx, components/story/scene/*). It is the reference for new pages, 3D props and motion, so they stay in the same night-baseplate world. Colours are the CSS tokens themselves, not estimates from screenshots.

color.palette_type: dark monochrome navy with one cool accent; warm sunset tints only in the last chapter

primary.role: warm off-white for headlines and body copy on the navy baseplate

accent.role: muted Roblox blue: focus rings, active chips, the focus ring on the tech conveyor, the showcase dots

neutral.usage: Lightest end is foreground text on the #0a0f18 background; #929caf is muted meta text (still AA on the background); #142035 is the raised surface. Borders are rgba(200, 220, 255, 0.12 / 0.28).

color.contrast_strategy: Light text on deep navy with low-alpha cool borders. Brand colours appear only as content (tech logos in their real colours, BrickColor bricks, group stripes language #ffb86b / framework #6ee7ff / tool #c3a6ff), never as UI chrome.

font_families.heading: Archivo (300-600, latin + vietnamese)
font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono / SFMono-Regular / Menlo (canvas labels on the 3D floor)

typography.font_style_notes: Tight negative tracking on big Archivo headlines, wide-tracked uppercase overlines (chapter eyebrows like 02 / 04 — TECH STACK), tabular numerals for the HUD readout (STORY 008%). Vietnamese diacritics must survive every size.

spacing.content_density: sparse: one statement per viewport, copy column on the left, the 3D scene owns the rest
spacing.section_rhythm: scroll-length chapters (hundreds of vh) rather than stacked sections; the story value 0..4 drives the scene

layout.grid_system: fixed full-bleed WebGL stage behind a single left copy column plus fixed HUD (header, leaderboard, chapter rail, footer readout)
layout.columns: 1 (copy) over a full-bleed scene; HUD pinned to the corners
layout.alignment_tendency: left-aligned copy, character framed right of centre; on portrait phones copy on top and Sussy below

border_radius.large: TV housing and plinths are rounded boxes in 3D

shape.border_usage: 1px hairlines in rgba(200, 220, 255, 0.12); strong 0.28 for active states
shape.divider_style: thin horizontal rules beside eyebrows and in the HUD; no heavy dividers

elevation.shadow_style: soft dark drops plus inset bottom edges that read like Roblox UI buttons
elevation.depth_cues: real 3D depth from the scene (fog, AgX tone mapping, blob shadow); DOM layers use glass blur instead of big shadows

iconography.style: full-colour brand marks extruded in 3D for the tech stack; simple-icons paths as fallback and in the chips
iconography.size_scale: 1.6 studs per logo on a 2.4-stud plinth; 24px icons in DOM
iconography.preferred_set: devicon originals, official SVGs (luau.org, roblox-ts.com), simple-icons (CC0)

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for DOM; damped springs (damp) for the camera and Sussy; sine for ambient loops
motion.entrance_pattern: rise and settle: copy slides up 1.75rem with opacity, panels slide in from the left, props rise from below with a decelerating ease and a 70ms stagger
motion.exit_pattern: fade upwards before sliding under the fixed header; studio props sink as the door opens
motion.philosophy: Corporate-calm UI, playful character. Scroll speed drives Sussy (walk vs run); nothing loops fast; reduced motion freezes ambient motion and keeps every state reachable.

components.button_style: ghost buttons with hairline borders; Roblox-like inset bottom edge on active chips
components.card_style: glass cards (surface rgba with blur) with hairline border
components.navigation_pattern: fixed header + right chapter rail with growing line + J/K keys + scene clicks
components.modal_style: none; the showcase panel is a fixed left dock, a bottom sheet on phones
components.list_style: grouped chips in fieldsets (language / framework / tool) with coloured legends
components.component_notes: Leaderboard HUD (PLAYER / STAGE / STUDS) and the chat bubble over Sussy's head are the Roblox signatures; keep them.

aesthetic.mood: quiet night in Roblox Studio, then a warm sunset walk
aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a playable level: baseplate studio, a door, a road with roadside TVs, a tree to sit under
aesthetic.era_influence: modern Roblox (2022 tilt logo, R6 avatar, BrickColors) with a calm editorial layer

visual_language.ornamentation: low in DOM, functional in 3D (tools, studs, neon group stripes)
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous; the scene is the whitespace
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: headline left, character right; props frame the top band only
visual_language.focal_strategy: Sussy is always the focal point; props and logos sit around, never over, the copy or HUD
visual_language.contrast_level: high for text, low for chrome
visual_language.texture_usage: procedural studs on the floor, turf noise in the meadow, CRT scanlines on the TVs

composition.hierarchy_method: scale of the Archivo headline, then eyebrow, then lede
composition.flow_direction: vertical scroll mapped to a left-to-right walk along the road
composition.grouping_strategy: chapters (01-04) and tech shelves (language / framework / tool)
composition.negative_space_role: keeps the 3D scene readable behind the copy

imagery.photo_treatment: none; project screens are captured frames shown on CRT TVs
imagery.illustration_style: low-poly real-time 3D modelled in Blender, Roblox proportions

interaction_feel.feedback_style: the scene answers: hover lifts a logo, click makes Sussy jump, scroll speed sets the gait
interaction_feel.transition_personality: smooth, damped, never bouncy on UI
interaction_feel.loading_style: Sussy's head rolling along a row of studs in the bottom-right corner, at least 3.5s, at most 15s

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: plain, first person, a little playful (gg! Mình là Sussy.)
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: informal Vietnamese with an English toggle
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: short verbs (Liên hệ, Đọc case study)
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: say it plainly: Đang cập nhật
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: calm; the page falls back to a static poster instead of showing an error

overview.performance_tier: adaptive: DPR tiers 1.5/1.25/1/0.8 with warm-up, fewer grass instances on touch devices
overview.fallback_strategy: static poster when WebGL fails, a load rejects or a lost context does not come back within 4s; reduced motion renders only on change
overview.primary_technology: three.js (WebGLRenderer, AgX tone mapping, RoomEnvironment PMREM), Blender-built GLBs with meshopt

background_effects.type: gradient sky dome with stars at dusk
background_effects.description: Studio: deep navy fog and a stud grid. Sunset: shader sky mixing to warm tones, then night stars when Sussy sits.

particle_systems.type: fireflies, falling leaves, a flock of birds
particle_systems.description: Points sprites over the meadow at sunset only

params.shape: soft dots, leaf ellipses, V-shaped birds
params.movement_pattern: sine drift, fall with spin, slow flight across the sky
params.spawn_area: around the road and the tree

3d_elements.description: R6 Sussy rig with Roblox animations, tech conveyor of full-colour extruded logos on plinths, floating studio toolbox (claw hammer, sledgehammer, wrench, screwdriver, studded bricks), door to a meadow road with CRT TVs

params.lighting: key + rim + hemisphere + PMREM room environment; fill light at arrival
params.materials: MeshStandard PBR; vertex-coloured logos without tone mapping; plastic bricks tinted per instance
params.geometry: Blender GLBs (meshopt) and extruded SVG layers
params.interaction_model: scroll scrubs the story; hover/click on logos and Sussy

shader_effects.type: CRT screens, door light flood, turf noise, sky
shader_effects.description: Screen-space flood from the door, scanlines on the TVs, noise on the ground

parallax.layers: camera parallax between conveyor, character and background props

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: chapter boundaries 0.65 / 1.65, door at 2.3, showcase stops measured from the DOM
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: continuous, damped towards the scroll target

scroll_morphing.description: studio floor sinks and the meadow rises through the door

text_effects.description: copy fades and lifts as it enters and before it slides under the header

cursor_effects.description: native cursor; hover is handled in the 3D scene

image_effects.description: project captures drawn cover-fit on a canvas texture behind a scanline shader; power-on with distance

canvas_drawings.description: floor labels (LANGUAGE / FRAMEWORK / TOOL), SpawnLocation ring and TV screens are drawn on 2D canvases and used as textures
